name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-dev-v12
description: HARNESS for @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext. Never published. The payload is ./pkg.
//: Rule 9: this manifest carries every devDependency, every build/test script and all tooling config;
the published manifest in ./pkg carries none of them. `.npmignore` cannot achieve that split --
it filters files, not manifest fields.
No `workspaces` field on purpose: this package is a MEMBER of the sdk/ workspace, not a workspace
root of its own. Its ./pkg is deliberately NOT a member -- every generation's payload shares one
published name, so only the current generation's pkg can be listed (see sdk/plans/ARCHITECTURE.md
I3). npm therefore does not install ./pkg's dependencies, so the payload's Solidity deps are
MIRRORED below as devDependencies -- forge resolves them from this directory's node_modules via
`libs` in foundry.toml. Keep the versions in lockstep with pkg/package.json.
Solidity is formatted and linted by FORGE ONLY -- `forge fmt` / `forge lint`, settings shared from
sdk/foundry.base.toml via `extends` in foundry.toml and gated by check:forge-fmt-config.
prettier handles js/json/md/ts/yml and CANNOT touch .sol: prettier has no Solidity parser of its
own, so removing prettier-plugin-solidity makes it structurally incapable rather than merely
configured off. .prettierignore lists *.sol as a second line of defence.
The forge version is pinned in .foundry-version and asserted by check:forge-version, which runs
FIRST in build. It is load-bearing: pkg/src/contracts is stored forge-formatted and check:vendored
compares it against `forge fmt`(upstream), so a different forge changes what that gate expects.
`build` ends with prepare:tarball-consumer on purpose: it starts with `clean`, which removes
test/ts/node_modules, and those tests import the package by its PUBLISHED name. Re-creating the
fixture leaves a built tree self-consistent instead of leaving test/ts unresolvable in editors.

scripts.clean: rm -rf cache out broadcast internal/.deploy-config internal/.tmp-localhost *.tsbuildinfo internal/*.tsbuildinfo test/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/ts/*.tsbuildinfo pkg/ts/_esm pkg/ts/_cjs pkg/ts/_types && npm run clean:tarball-consumer
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check:forge-version && npm run check:forge-fmt-config && npm run check:vendored && npm run prettier:check && npm run forge:fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run check:zama-config && npm run check:cleartext-config && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:types && npm run test:publint && npm run prepare:tarball-consumer && npm run lint:tarball-consumer
scripts.build:tarball: npm run build:templates && npm run build && npm run pack:tarball
scripts.build:templates: npm run generate:cleartext-config && npm run generate:contract-versions && npm run generate:compute-addresses && npm run generate:placeholders && npm run build:forge && node internal/cli/generateTemplates.ts && node internal/cli/generateSigners.ts && npm run generate:local-host-bytecode
scripts.generate:templates: node internal/cli/generateTemplates.ts && node internal/cli/generateSigners.ts && npm run generate:local-host-bytecode
scripts.test: npm run clean:tarball-consumer && npm run build:templates && npm run test:templates:run && npm run test:forge && npm run test:tarball:run
scripts.test:templates: npm run clean:tarball-consumer && npm run build:templates && npm run test:templates:run
scripts.test:tarball: npm run clean:tarball-consumer && npm run build:templates && npm run test:tarball:run
scripts.test:tarball:run: npm run build && vitest run --config test/ts/vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint: npm run check:lint-policy && npm run forge:lint && eslint && tsc -b ./tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./create2-deploy/tsconfig.json --noEmit
